evals.prompt: I just had a training call with my new VA about how to pull foreclosure records from the Knox County public notice site. Here's the transcript from the call. Can you turn this into an SOP they can follow on their own? [transcript attached - the Sync meeting PDF from the conversation]
evals.expected_output: A complete SOP pair: the human doc (process map flowchart, steps with action-verb instructions naming exact UI labels, decision trees for qualifying records, screenshot capture specs with capture/highlight/crop lines, a worked example, a Done-when line, and a quality checklist at 5th-grade reading level) PLUS an agent-executable .sop.md twin with Overview, snake_case Parameters with the acquisition-constraints block, numbered steps with RFC 2119 constraints, reasons on every negative constraint, and artifact paths. The twin passes scripts/validate_sop.py.

evals.prompt: Create a playbook for how to do sequential marketing with Sift. Cover the full funnel from pulling first-to-market data through skip tracing, calling, and mail campaigns. Our team uses Sift presets to move leads through stages.
evals.expected_output: A strategic playbook with a central metaphor, overview process map showing the full marketing funnel, decision trees for which channel to use when, screenshot capture specs for Sift interfaces, a worked example, and best practices. Should include a Mermaid swim lane diagram showing the team workflow.

evals.prompt: Write me a quick SOP for how to deep prospect a lead when skip tracing doesn't return any phone numbers. The process is: check the verified dashboard in Sift, look up the property, use people search sites like TruePeopleSearch and CyberBackgroundChecks to find the actual owner, cross-reference ages and locations, then add the verified numbers back into Sift with notes.
evals.expected_output: A focused SOP pair: human doc with a clear process map, step-by-step actions for each research stage, decision tree for verifying you have the right person, screenshot specs for each tool, a worked example, and common problems table; plus a deep-prospect .sop.md twin whose steps write their findings to named artifact files and whose constraints forbid inventing phone numbers, with a stated reason.

evals.prompt: Make me a guide like Scribe for uploading a CSV into DataSift, so I can hand it to a brand new VA. Just the clicks, nothing fancy.
evals.expected_output: A Step Guide in the Scribe format: title under 60 characters naming the app and task, a metadata line (N steps, created date, source), zero-padded '## Step 01:' headings where each heading is one action-verb sentence naming the exact UI label in bold, exactly one screenshot spec (capture/highlight/crop) per step, typing coalesced to one step per field, no flowcharts, and a closing 'Done when' with a result screenshot spec.

evals.prompt: Here's our old written checklist for qualifying probate records. Turn it into something an AI agent can actually run on its own, and keep a human version for training too.
evals.expected_output: Both artifacts: an updated human SOP from the template, and a qualify-probate-records.sop.md agent twin following the four structural invariants (.sop.md name, Overview, Parameters with acquisition constraints, numbered steps with RFC 2119 constraint blocks). Parameter names match the human doc's Inputs table. The response shows the validator being run and passing.
